scope: V12 client source unchanged; source catalogs repinned to independently reviewed release overlay.
limits: V13 repins the independently reviewed release-tooling overlay. Client Rust patches, controls, baseline cases, targets and timing are unchanged from v12; v13 has not run natively.

V12 added timeout-only mock observations to an existing retained-backing test without changing assertions or timing. The v12 run is tracked separately; no result is assumed by this source preparation.

V11 stages producer queue v2 and a separate JoinGroup wire-order control. Both have static peer reviews but have not been compiled, run or benchmarked. The original two-response control remains unchanged and required.
Producer optimization only avoids some expiry and deadline scans. Vec prefix shifts, nonmonotonic fallback and sticky scans remain; arbitrary resumption of an interrupted split is unqualified.
V10 at b1 passed 2280 library tests in each profile and strict format/Clippy but failed 15 mock tests and a retained-backing timeout per profile; the v10 gate failed.
V10 preparation added a handshake overlap diagnostic; it passed both profiles at b1. The original 450 ms end-to-end test remains unchanged and failed in v7, v8 and v10. No performance fix is claimed.

V10 preparation added a test-only response gate and zero-delay correction. At b1 the new gate control, format and Clippy passed in both profiles, while the original retained-backing case still timed out. The timeout cause is not proven.

V9 preparation changed source pins for five release-related files and added the registry probe test to all phases, preserving the v8 Rust patches and test matrix. V9 was not run as a distinct candidate.

V8 preparation combined v7, two test repairs and worker-owned producer terminal/retry/split/response changes. Its later run at 350b5e534 passed 2,280 library tests per profile and format/Clippy, but failed 15 Mock Produce tests and one retained-backing test per profile.

V7 native runs reached runtime and failed: each library 2253/1, Mock Produce 31/15, retained backing 7/1/1 ignored; two Clippy test errors and two baseline expectation mismatches. V8 test repairs do not address the 15 handshake failures or retained-backing timeout.

V8 preparation changed two baseline predictions after v7 passes. The original cancellation case then failed in v8 and v10; v11/v12 retain that unchanged case as an observation and add a separate predicted-negative wire control.
Full runs of ten chosen binaries in default/all-feature lanes are required; other integration binaries and ordinary whole-main runtime remain separate gates.
Runtime stack remains 8 MiB except an explicit standard 2 MiB group child; this mock does not establish live Kafka stack safety.
All 26 added producer ownership controls passed in both v8 library profiles. Broader cancellation, retry, callback, accounting and runtime behavior still needs qualification.
Issue ordering, sequence wrap, PID/epoch transitions, whole-batch replay and physical socket retirement before ambiguous retry remain unresolved.
Hashing/map growth, final Drop, callbacks and deque-suffix conversion can perform linear synchronous work; global memory and cancellation latency are not bounded.
No external broker, multi-node durability, release readiness or fastest-performance ranking is established.
